title: PANINI browser (Playwright)
summary: PANINI's own persistent Edge/Chrome profile driven by Playwright: pages as accessibility snapshots with element refs, auto-waiting clicks and typing.

principles: PANINI's browser (managed_*) is separate from the person's Chrome: use it when they ask for a separate browser or when their Chrome is not connected.
Work from the latest snapshot: act on element refs and describe each element exactly as the snapshot names it.
After an action, check the returned page state (or managed_verify_text) before saying it worked.

tools.name: managed_navigate
tools.title: Open a page
tools.description: Open a web address in PANINI's own browser (a separate, persistent Edge/Chrome profile, not the person's Chrome). Returns the page's accessibility snapshot with element refs.

tools.name: managed_snapshot
tools.title: Read the page
tools.description: Read the current page in PANINI's browser as an accessibility snapshot: text, controls and element refs (e12) to act on.

tools.name: managed_click
tools.title: Click
tools.description: Click an element in PANINI's browser by its ref from the latest snapshot. Describe the element exactly as the snapshot names it. Returns the page state after the click.

element.description: The element as the snapshot names it, for example 'Search button'.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, for example e12.

tools.name: managed_type
tools.title: Type
tools.description: Type text into a field in PANINI's browser by its ref; submit: true presses Enter afterwards. Never for passwords or security codes.

element.description: The element as the snapshot names it, for example 'Search button'.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, for example e12.

tools.name: managed_select
tools.title: Choose an option
tools.description: Choose one or more options in a dropdown in PANINI's browser by its ref.

element.description: The element as the snapshot names it, for example 'Search button'.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, for example e12.

tools.name: managed_press_key
tools.title: Press a key
tools.description: Press a key in PANINI's browser, for example Enter, Escape, ArrowDown or PageDown.

tools.name: managed_wait_for
tools.title: Wait
tools.description: Wait until text appears in PANINI's browser, or for a number of seconds (at most 30). Use an empty string or 0 for the unused field.

tools.name: managed_tabs
tools.title: Tabs
tools.description: List, open, close or switch tabs in PANINI's browser. index: the tab number for close/select (-1 when unused); url: for new (empty when unused).

tools.name: managed_back
tools.title: Go back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page in PANINI's browser.

tools.name: managed_screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page in PANINI's browser.

tools.name: managed_verify_text
tools.title: Check text is visible
tools.description: Check that a text is visible on the current page in PANINI's browser; use it to confirm a result before reporting it.
